SocialSchemeProvider.title: SocialSchemeProvider
SocialSchemeProvider.description: Network-agnostic generic layer. Inherits from Beckn core Attributes. The ION-specific layer (IONSocialSchemeProviderAttributes) extends this via allOf.

IONSocialSchemeProviderAttributes.description:
Indonesia-specific operational and empanelment attributes for a
Provider offering scheme discovery and application services on ION.

providerType.description: Nature of this Provider's relationship to the schemes it publishes.

operatingRegions.description: BPS province codes where this Provider actively offers application assistance.

nibRegistered.description: Whether the Provider organisation holds a valid NIB. Required for EMPANELLED_FACILITATION_PARTNER and NGO_REFERRAL_PARTNER provider types.

dataHandlingCertification.description: Certification or self-declaration status for UU PDP 2022 compliant handling of beneficiary personal data.

Empanelment.description: Formal authorisation status linking this Provider to the government schemes it is permitted to receive applications for. Absent for providerType GOVERNMENT_AGENCY_DIRECT, since a ministry is self-authorising for its own schemes.

empanelmentId.description: Identifier issued by the implementing agency or SLRT registry for this Provider's authorisation.

empaneledSchemeIds.description: Resource IDs of the schemes this Provider is authorised to process applications for. Empty array means all published schemes are within scope.

CaseworkerNetwork.description: Summary of the Provider's field caseworker capacity — informational, used by Buyer Apps to set expectations on facilitation availability.

fieldVisitAvailable.description: Whether caseworkers can conduct in-person document collection / home visits.

Helpline.description: Applicant-facing support contact for this Provider.
